page_title: Animate Your Ideas, Design Better Apps

sources.entry: Principle - Application for designing animated and interactive user interfaces.

summary.name: Principle
summary.one_liner: Principle is a native macOS app for designing animated and interactive user interfaces, including multi-screen app flows and prototypes.
use_cases: Importing Figma or Sketch designs to animate
Sharing interactive prototypes in a browser
Exporting design animations as video or GIF for Dribbble or Twitter
summary.what_it_does: Principle lets designers build animations and interactions on a timeline, with artboards and a bird's-eye view of multi-screen app flows. Designs can be imported from Figma or Sketch, and re-importing merges changes into existing work. Users can pick a device preset or custom artboard size, and add hover events and mouse wheel scrolling for web and desktop prototypes. Prototypes can be shared to the web with one click for viewing in a browser, and a record feature exports video or animated GIF.
notable: Timeline-based animation editor with artboards and a bird's-eye view of all screens
Imports designs from Figma or Sketch and merges changes on re-import
Native macOS app with Intel and Apple Silicon support, Retina interface, and Auto Save
One-click web sharing that viewers can open in a browser without installing anything
caveats: The page does not state pricing or whether the app is free or paid
Design authoring runs as a native Mac app; the page does not describe a Windows or Linux version of the editor, only that shared designs can be viewed on those platforms
